text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Coming up from the innermost rail is Kitasan Black!
Kitasan Black! Kitasan Black!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: —HAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHH!!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
It's a festival!!
Yodo is a festival!! A Kitasan Festival!!!
(WOOOOOOOOOOH!!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I did it――

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: —All riiiiight!!!!!
(WOOOOOOOOOOH!!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ......Congratulations, Kitasan Black.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...I too, must move on to the next—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: —Bravissimo!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Magnificent, Kitasan Black……!!
A melody truly fit for a festival……!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"The heat in this venue...!
Ah, you are without a doubt one of the musicians
who will ignite the races to come...!"
A few days later—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: —Ah, there you are...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I heard the sound of a violin
and wondered if it might be you—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Hey, Kitasan!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Congratulations on your recent Kikuka Sho win!
It was a melody so true to you that it made my heart tremble...!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much...! I truly believe
it's all because Earth-san helped me look forward!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: "So, um... It might be a bit much to call it a return gift, but—"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
—I'm going to run in
this year's Japan Cup!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I want to convey my "melodia"
directly to Earth-san there...!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: —Molto bene...!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Aren't you a sweet talker,
Kitasan—"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
My heart fluttered so much.
—Just like being in love.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Whaa!?
L-L-Love...!?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Um, well, did I—did I say something weird?!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, no.
It just means... you were that straightforward.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
I'm looking forward to the Japan Cup.
Let's make it a wonderful race...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
“—And so, that's what happened...!
It looks like Kitasan will be
running in the Japan Cup!”

The "Ultimate Session Transcending Generations" that Sounds of Earth aims for.
A major piece of that puzzle is beginning to fall into place.
Seeing her efforts bear fruit like this makes me as happy as if it were my own success, and I can't stop feeling excited for her future races...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Ah! Let this emotion turn into sound—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"...Pardon me, Direttore.
Would you mind if I invited a guest in here?"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"...Pardon me, Direttrice.
Would you mind if I invited a guest in here?"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
I happen to be a bit sensitive to sound, you see—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
You're there, aren't you, Cheval Grand?
...Come on in.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: —...Excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"...Your footsteps sound different.
I can feel your determination."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Earth-san.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: First of all... thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...Thanks to you...
I've been taking small steps since that day...
and I've finally... made it "here."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...I'm going to run in the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
That is why, against Kita-san... and you...
I want to strike with everything I've got right now.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...To you, who always encouraged me...
this is all I can offer right now, but—"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: —Molto bene!!!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: "There's no other way"?! That's ridiculous, Cheval!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Magnificent! What a passionate proposal...!
Ah...! I want to embrace you right this instant...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: H-Huuuug... H-Hug me...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
I can hardly wait!
To race against you in the Japan Cup...!!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Um... Please take care of me.
That night—
On the deserted stage, as Sounds of Earth and I passionately vented our mounting excitement for the future races—
――Sfera.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"AMRT"... Very good music.
I feel "excitement."

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Universe-san...!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Today, yet another... major "distortion."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Yet that is the "Up Quark"...
It has become even more "dazzling."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: ......Neo Universe will ask a "question".

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Sounds of Earth... is still advancing through the phase without change...?

"Neo Universe's words were extremely esoteric.
However, Sounds of Earth did not seem
confused by them at all—"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: ...My answer won't change.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: "If anything, I can answer with even greater determination than before...!"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
I march onward! In pursuit of the ultimate music!!
Guided by my overflowing passion!!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
I'm looking forward to the Japan Cup
and the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe also... wants to listen.
"MSIC"... to your "music".

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
...!
Yeah, please look forward to it...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
I'll definitely make sure to satisfy
Universe-san!
Their exchange feels connected by something far beyond mere words...
choice_data_list: (For some reason, that warms my heart...)
(For some reason, that really warms my heart...)

text_block_list.text:
A multitude of emotions converge.
It became a night where you could almost hear that 'sound'—
